children: NCS Multistage terminated all commitments under its May 2022 Credit Agreement led by JPMorgan following the closing of its merger. On the Closing Date, the company repaid all outstanding obligations in full, and all related liens and guarantees were released. The early termination aligns financing with its new parent structure and concludes the company’s standalone credit facility.
: JPMorgan Chase Bank, as administrative agent, and other lenders
: Completed merger and repayment of outstanding obligations
